notes: Background: mid-market UX analytics SaaS, heavy on search/ranking features inside product help + in-app knowledge base.
Primary interest: introduce a reranking endpoint to boost click-through relevance and session-level satisfaction metrics.
Workflow: current stack uses BM25 + small transformer model for initial retrieval; they want Redwood to provide a second-stage reranker (online and offline scoring).
POC plan: start on Hosted API for speed-to-value; move to Dedicated if POC meets latency/cost SLOs and security sign-off (VPC + KMS).
POC dataset: 200k historical queries + judged relevance labels (internal eval set ~12k queries, binary and graded relevance), offline scoring + NDCG/MRR baselines agreed.
Latency/throughput targets: 30 qps steady-state for online rerank; target p95 <200ms for rerank calls; offline batch scoring for nightly re-rank of heavy corpora (~3M docs) accepted.
Cost sensitivity: product team cites 40% uplift allowed vs baseline inference cost for 3x relevance improvement; must present unit economics for hosted vs dedicated with committed capacity options.
Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified curated models for reproducibility; request ability to pin model versions and fallback to a smaller quantized variant for bursts.
Routing/fallback: need policy for autoscale fallback to lower-capacity variant + cross-region failover if Dedicated pool saturated.
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration for dev console, audit logs for inference requests, 90-day retention controls, KMS for keys, and EU data residency for EU customers.
Quotes from CRO: 'We want measurable lift on session-level conversion — if rerank moves the needle by >6% we'll accelerate committed spend.'
Demo notes (2026-02-20): showed Hosted API rerank endpoint, streaming vs non-streaming not relevant for rerank; showed how to upload eval set, run offline scoring, view NDCG diff in Console.
Security review (2026-03-03): security sent initial questionnaire; outstanding: HSM/KMS admin flow detail + network egress patterns for VPC option.
POC kickoff (2026-03-01): dataset ingestion completed; Redwood provided sample scoring script and eval runner; first offline run scheduled 2026-03-10.
POC metrics to validate: delta NDCG@10, MRR, p95 latency, cost per 1k rerank calls. Acceptance criteria doc in Drive link.
Finance/pricing conversation (2026-03-05): negotiating committed monthly capacity vs burst pricing; AE to produce 3 pricing scenarios (hosted POC, 6-mo Dedicated pilot, 12-mo committed).
Operational ask: ability to export per-request logs (obfuscated PII) for product analytics and to replay offline scoring for A/B analyses.
Next demo: internal eng review 2026-03-18 to show Dedicated instance sizing and autoscale policies; infra deep-dive scheduled for 2026-03-22.
Notes for SE: prepare quantized model performance report, typical token lengths for rerank requests (avg 120 tokens), and sample inference cost projections at 30 qps and 100 qps burst.
Customer sentiment: enthusiastic about results so far; primary resistance from security and finance for Dedicated commitment level.
